name: Jerahmeel
overview: Jerahmeel is a male descendant of the tribe of Levi, specifically noted as the son of Kish and a descendant of Mahli. His identification is grounded in the genealogical record found in 1 Chronicles 24:29. There are no additional notes or details about his life or role beyond these lineage facts.
namesAndTitles: The name Jerahmeel means 'G-d [El] will have compassion,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning common in Hebrew names. This proper name was not given directly by God but carries a significant divine attribute in its meaning, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 24:29.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jerahmeel as the son of Kish, linking him within the Levitical family line descending from Mahli. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jerahmeel's significance lies primarily in his place within the Levitical genealogies, which were crucial for organizing the priestly divisions in ancient Israel. As a descendant of Mahli and son of Kish, he represents a link in the priestly lineage that served the temple, as documented in 1 Chronicles 24:29. His name's meaning underscores God's compassion, fitting for a Levite involved in worship and service.
